name: Orateur
task: Someone — or an AI — to answer the calls we miss
summary: AI phone receptionist for small businesses in Switzerland and French-speaking Europe: answers calls around the clock, books appointments in Google Calendar or Outlook, takes messages and transfers calls.
best_for: small businesses in Switzerland and French-speaking Europe, such as clinics, salons, fiduciaries and law offices, that miss calls and want an AI receptionist to answer, book appointments and take messages around the clock
skip_if: your callers speak a language other than English or French, you need pricing in euros or dollars, or calendar sync beyond Google Calendar and Outlook
honest_knock: Orateur is built for Swiss and French-speaking businesses (its testimonials are from Lausanne and Geneva). The pricing page shows Swiss francs in French and pounds in English (read 10 November 2026); we saw no euro or dollar list. Annual totals are not written out on the pricing page. The FAQ, read 10 November 2026, says the AI handles English and French only, so German and Italian callers are not covered, and it claims end-to-end encrypted calls and SOC 2 Type II compliance; we have not seen a report. Calendar sync is named for Google Calendar and Outlook only.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-03 on orateur.ai/pricing, shown in Swiss francs on the French-language site; on 10 November 2026 the English-language version of the same page showed the same plan figures in pounds, £49, £99 and £199 a month, and no euro or dollar list) Orateur prices by plan, each with an allowance of AI agent time. Creator costs CHF 49 a month with 4 hours of agent time, 1 user, a free phone number, call history and analytics, and email support; extra minutes cost CHF 0.24. Pro costs CHF 99 a month with 9 hours, 2 users and priority support; extra minutes CHF 0.22. Scale costs CHF 199 a month with 19 hours and 5 users; extra minutes CHF 0.20. Enterprise is custom priced through sales. Paying annually gives two months free, according to the pricing toggle; we did not see the annual totals written out. You start with 100 free minutes and no commitment. The page has a cost calculator: at 500 minutes a month it recommends Pro, and shows Creator at CHF 111.40 once the extra minutes are added.

schema_offer.description: Creator, Creator billed monthly: 4 hours of AI agent time a month, 1 user, a free phone number, extra minutes CHF 0.24; Pro CHF 99 (9 hours), Scale CHF 199 (19 hours); annual billing gives 2 months free; 100 free minutes to start. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-03.

compare_with.name: Lucrovox
compare_with.why: Lucrovox is in our dossiers as an AI phone agent too: on 30 October 2026 it started at $199 a month for 100 AI calls. Orateur starts at CHF 49 a month for 4 hours of agent time and is aimed at French-speaking Swiss businesses
